description: Use this tool to read the actual text of reviews left for a named seller, paginated. Use it when the user wants to know what past clients actually said about a specific freelancer, not just their rating score — for the rating and count alone, use get_seller_reviews_summary.

end_cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response; pass it back to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return (10–50, default 20).

name: list_seller_reviews
title: Freelancer Reviews
